title: Shortest roads
description:
Find the shortest road route between towns with Dijkstra's algorithm.

```
from Ashby to Dunmore: 14 km via Ashby -> Bray -> Carr -> Dunmore
from Ashby to Eston: unreachable
```
hints: When you pop a town whose distance is bigger than the best known, it is stale: `continue` (lesson 5.03).
For the route, follow `previous[town]` back from the end and reverse the list.
requirements: Weighted edges in an adjacency list of `(neighbour, km)`.
A `std::priority_queue` of `(distance, town)`, smallest first; skip stale entries.
Rebuild the route from a "previous" map.
stretch: Use A* on a grid with the Manhattan distance and count how many cells each algorithm visits.
